verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents an official first-party MCP server that lets AI clients such as Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Windsurf control a browser, exposing 117 browser and automation tools. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and documented setup/authentication details in the evidence pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
